findings.symptom: A flow-local let bound to a TransitionDecision and used by yield passed checking, but generated Go referenced a nonexistent persisted flow field.
findings.workaround: Yield Decide(...) directly and retain only explicit workflow facts on the private board.

findings.symptom: when utility with record-valued candidates materialized excessive candidate data.
findings.evidence: about 1050 ns, 4240 B/op, 2 allocs/op before the outcome-code rewrite
findings.workaround: Score Int outcome codes, then construct one typed decision through a closed switch; about 300 ns, 576 B/op, 1 alloc/op.

findings.symptom: A nominal record yield is retained through an internal any slot and allocates once per turn.
findings.evidence: 576 B/op and 1 alloc/op for generated Step plus Yielded
findings.workaround: Accepted for M0; preserve as a future typed-yield lowering target.
